title_en: The Issue of Awaiting and the Role of the Religious Authority (Marja'iyya) During the Era of the Greater Occultation
description_en: From the meeting of His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure), with a female delegation from the seminaries (hawza) in Hijaz.
summary: Religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses the concept of anticipation (intizar) and the responsibilities of the religious authority (marja'iyya) while awaiting the return of the Mahdi.
